title: Targeting the TEA DNA binding Domain of TEAD with a Peptide Inhibitor TEAi Suppresses Oncogenic Transcription and Tumor Growth
authors: Hui Xiong; Ruohui Han; Xiaohui Lin; Shian Wu; Lei Cao
one_liner_zh: 该文开发靶向TEAD DNA结合域的肽抑制剂TEAi，通过抑制TEAD-DNA结合阻断致癌转录，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作机制但以湿实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，故评分为6。
abstract: The Hippo pathway is a critical regulator of organ size and tumorigenesis, with the TEAD-YAP/TAZ transcriptional complex serving as a key effector frequently hyperactivated in cancers. Targeting this complex has emerged as a promising anticancer strategy. Here, we develop TEAi, a 64-amino acid peptide derived from Drosophila Nerfin-1, which directly binds the TEA DNA-binding domain of TEAD. TEAi potently suppressed TEAD-YAP-driven transcriptional activity, as evidenced by luciferase reporter and qPCR assays targeting canonical downstream genes CTGF and CYR61. Mechanistically, TEAi inhibited the DNA-binding capacity of TEAD2 without direct DNA interaction, thereby abolishing promoter recruitment of the TEAD-YAP complex. unexpectedly, TEAi induced nuclear export and cytoplasmic accumulation of TEAD2, suggesting a non-canonical mechanism distinct from native Nerfin-1 function. Functionally, TEAi significantly suppressed cancer cell proliferation in vitro and tumor growth in vivo. Unlike inhibitors targeting the YAP-binding interface, TEAi directly blocks the DNA-binding activity of TEAD, offering a potential advantage by comprehensively inhibiting all TEAD-dependent oncogenic transcription. Our findings establish TEAi as a promising prototype for therapeutics targeting TEAD, with implications for treating cancers driven by Hippo pathway dysregulation.
abstract_zh: Hippo通路是器官大小和肿瘤发生的关键调控因子，其中TEAD-YAP/TAZ转录复合物作为关键效应因子，在癌症中经常过度激活。靶向该复合物已成为一种有前景的抗癌策略。在此，我们开发了TEAi，一种源自果蝇Nerfin-1的64氨基酸肽，它直接结合TEAD的TEA DNA结合域。TEAi有效抑制TEAD-YAP驱动的转录活性，这通过荧光素酶报告基因和qPCR实验靶向经典下游基因CTGF和CYR61得到证实。机制上，TEAi抑制TEAD2的DNA结合能力而不直接与DNA相互作用，从而消除TEAD-YAP复合物在启动子上的募集。出乎意料的是，TEAi诱导TEAD2的核输出和细胞质积累，提示其作用机制不同于天然Nerfin-1的非经典途径。功能上，TEAi在体外显著抑制癌细胞增殖，并在体内抑制肿瘤生长。与靶向YAP结合界面的抑制剂不同，TEAi直接阻断TEAD的DNA结合活性，通过全面抑制所有TEAD依赖性致癌转录，提供了潜在优势。我们的发现将TEAi确立为靶向TEAD治疗的有前景原型，对治疗Hippo通路失调驱动的癌症具有重要意义。
